title: Private Half Day Philadelphia Driving Tour with Local Guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the sights of Philadelphia with a personal guide on this private, half-day sightseeing tour. Hop in a comfortable minivan (for up to six people) and ride from river to river. See the Historic District, Penn's Landing, the Italian Market, Philadelphia City Hall, the South 9th Street Italian Market, the Rocky Steps at the entrance of the Philadelphia Museum of Art, and much more.
